description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: lib/zaq/accounts/people.ex, person_merger.ex, Connect-owned transactional transfer/cleanup helpers and Person grant/attempt schema constraints; test/zaq/accounts/* existing merge/deletion tests plus Connect concurrency cases. Accounts orchestrates identity lifecycle; Connect owns grant queries, collision rules, encrypted material handling and mutation jobs. Extend existing PersonMerger transaction/advisory-lock convention; do not create a second merge transaction. For each credential, transfer loser-only current grant to survivor; survivor-only unchanged; when both have rows retain survivor regardless of active/revoked/expired status and remove loser secret. Never overwrite survivor secret; retaining revoked survivor preserves explicit opt-out. Update constrained owner_id/person_id atomically and avoid decrypt/re-encrypt unless required. Revoke/cancel pending OAuth attempts for merged/deleted initiators rather than allowing callback to write survivor credentials implicitly. Permanently deleting Person deletes owned grants/secrets and pending attempts transactionally, including bulk deletion; produce safe events for former owner and survivor/credential dependencies as relevant before IDs disappear. Account for active executions using global fallback when a transferred grant becomes available: notify survivor even when no survivor grant existed.

Tests to add before implementation: loser-only, survivor-only, both rows for each status class; multiple credentials and multiple losers; survivor revoked versus loser active; no secret overwrite; delete and bulk delete; failed merge rollback preserves grants and emits no job; concurrent grant issue/refresh/OAuth callback against merge/delete; FK and unique constraints remain satisfied; transferred grant cannot be resolved for deleted loser. Test stale authenticated alias/session cannot gain survivor grant management by normalization alone.

Branches/paths validated: missing Person, merged aliases, duplicate merge request, collision across legacy and canonical grants. Decide legacy person-owned resource rows are prohibited in this slice so no unhandled orphan ownership lane. Use same deterministic lock order across canonical mutation and PersonMerger paths; explicitly test deadlock-sensitive interleavings. No People module query of token payloads; no secret values passed into lifecycle notifications. FK cascade is defense in depth, not replacement for application notifications.

Mocking plan: no internal mocks; real Repo/merge orchestration/Oban; independent transaction concurrency harness. Documentations to update: Accounts and Connect moduledocs, docs/services/engine.md Person lifetime ownership and stale-session rule, relevant identity documentation located during implementation. Coordinate existing merge coverage debt zaq-c1k without silently expanding unrelated work. >=95% touched-file coverage or measured explicit exception and follow-up.
title: [zaq-jrg] 8. Integrate Person grant cleanup and deterministic merge
